Hi Bettina, I can't set up the recurring Monday 08:00 "Coastal week ahead" digest. I don't have a scheduling tool in this session, so nothing would post on its own next Monday.

What I can do: when you ask me in #coastal-team, I'll read #coastal-team and #coastal-random and post the digest (last week's activity plus open customer items) straight away. If you need it automated, someone with scheduling access will have to set it up, and I can help write that request.
